2608.14505.title: RecipeNet: A Hierarchical Transformer for Recipe Data
2608.14505.paper_summary: Recipe data arises in domains such as materials synthesis, pharmaceutical formulation, and industrial manufacturing, where procedures are represented as ordered sequences of steps containing heterogeneous structured fields. Existing tabular learning methods typically flatten this structure into fixed-schema representations, limiting their ability to capture hierarchical field interactions and procedural dependencies. We propose RecipeNet, a hierarchical Transformer architecture that encodes field-level interactions within each step and sequential dependencies across steps through stacked Transformer encoders. Experiments on multiple recipe datasets and tasks demonstrate that RecipeNet consistently outperforms existing tabular models, highlighting the value of hierarchical and sequential modeling for recipe representation learning.
2608.14505.paper_summary_zh: 食譜數據出現在材料合成、藥物配方和工業製造等領域，其中程序被表示為包含異構結構欄位的有序步驟序列。現有的表格學習方法通常將這一結構展平為固定模式表示，限制了它們捕捉層次欄位互動和程序依賴性的能力。我們提出了RecipeNet，一種層次化的Transformer架構，通過堆疊的Transformer編碼器編碼每個步驟中的欄位級互動和步驟間的序列依賴性。在多個食譜數據集和任務上的實驗表明，RecipeNet始終優於現有的表格模型，突顯了層次化和序列建模在食譜表示學習中的價值。
